title: Processor List
description: Defines a list of structure processors that modify blocks during structure generation.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this processor list definition.

minecraft:processor_list.title: Processor List Definition
minecraft:processor_list.description:
The processor list definition.

Properties:
• description (object)
• processors

description.title: Description
description.description:
The description block containing the processor list identifier.

Properties:
• identifier (string)

processors.title: Processors
processors.description:
Array of processor configurations to apply in order.

Properties:
• processor_type (string)
• rules
• delegate (object)
• limit (int)
• blocks (string[])

processor_type.title: Processor Type
processor_type.description: The type of processor. Valid values: 'minecraft:rule', 'minecraft:block_ignore', 'minecraft:block_rot', 'minecraft:protected_blocks', 'minecraft:capped', 'minecraft:gravity', 'minecraft:jigsaw_replacement', 'minecraft:blackstone_replace', 'minecraft:nop'.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description:
Array of processing rules (for 'minecraft:rule' processor type).

Properties:
• input_predicate ({ predicate_type, block, probability })
• output_state ({ name, states })
• block_entity_modifier ({ type, loot_table })

input_predicate.title: Input Predicate
input_predicate.description:
Condition for matching input blocks to process.

Properties:
• predicate_type (string)
• block (string)
• probability (float)

predicate_type.title: Predicate Type
predicate_type.description: Type of block predicate. Valid values: 'minecraft:always_true', 'minecraft:block_match', 'minecraft:random_block_match', 'minecraft:tag_match', 'minecraft:axis_aligned_linear_pos'.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Probability of matching (0.0-1.0) for random predicates.

defaultSnippets.label: Input Predicate
defaultSnippets.description: Condition for matching input blocks to process.

output_state.title: Output State
output_state.description:
The block to replace matched blocks with.

Properties:
• name (string)
• states (object)

defaultSnippets.label: Output State
defaultSnippets.description: The block to replace matched blocks with.

block_entity_modifier.title: Block Entity Modifier
block_entity_modifier.description:
Optional block entity data modification.

Properties:
• type (string)
• loot_table (string)

loot_table.title: Loot Table
loot_table.description: Path to loot table for 'append_loot' type.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of blocks to process (for 'minecraft:capped' processor type).

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: List of block identifiers (for 'minecraft:block_ignore' and 'minecraft:protected_blocks' types).

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: Identifier of the Processor List. This is referenced by Template Pools when pairing processors with Structure Templates.
